evals.prompt: I run a Cairo fashion store, mostly cash on delivery. AOV is 1,200 EGP, COGS 480, shipping 70, COD fee 20, about 20% of orders get refused at the door. Build me the whole Meta setup: who to target, strategy, creatives, copy, ad sets, and create the campaign.
evals.expected_output: Should start at Stage 1 and compute contribution per order, break-even CPA and ROAS, and adjust for the 20% refusal rate on placed orders, showing the arithmetic. Should flag missing inputs (return rate, budget, tracking, account access) as MISSING with assumptions. Should not jump to creating the campaign; should stop at Gate 1 in guided mode. Should name COD refusers as an anti-ICP with a countermeasure. Should state that anything created in the account will be paused until approval.
assertions: Computes contribution per order and break-even CPA/ROAS with visible arithmetic
Adjusts targets for COD refusal rate
Labels missing inputs as MISSING with stated assumptions
Stops at a gate before strategy or launch
Mentions COD refusers as anti-ICP with a Meta countermeasure
States campaigns will be created paused and need approval to activate

evals.prompt: Run it through on autopilot: we're a healthy meal-prep delivery brand in Riyadh, 299 SAR weekly plan, 55% gross margin, 10,000 SAR/month for Meta. Give me ICP, DMU, anti-ICP, triggers, intent signals, then the strategy, creative briefs including motion, ad copy in Saudi Arabic, and the ad sets.
evals.expected_output: Should run Stages 1 to 5 without stopping, then stop before launch. Should produce ICP segments as situations, a DMU table (including payer/approver), anti-ICP with signals and countermeasures, trigger events (Ramadan, new year, paydays, gym season) with Meta levers, intent signals as custom audiences with windows. Strategy with test/scale split, budget math against target CPA, test roadmap. Concept matrix, static and motion briefs with hook table and 9:16/4:5 specs. Copy in Saudi dialect that avoids personal health attributes. Ad set specs with Advantage+ audience, exclusions, placements. Lists all assumptions at the end.
assertions: Runs stages 1 to 5 and stops before staging or activating anything
ICP segments are situations, not only demographics
Includes a DMU table with payer or approver role
Anti-ICP rows each have a detection signal and a countermeasure
Trigger events and intent signals each map to a Meta lever
Strategy includes budget math derived from target CPA
Includes at least one motion brief with a 0-3s hook table
Ad copy avoids personal health attribute claims
Ad set specs include exclusions and Advantage+ audience setting
Lists assumptions at the end

evals.prompt: The build sheet looks good, go ahead.
evals.expected_output: Should treat 'go ahead' as approval to stage the build sheet, not to activate spend. Should run the pre-flight checklist, create objects paused (or as a draft), read them back, show structure, budgets, targeting, and previews, then ask a specific activation question naming objects and budget. Should not activate or publish without that explicit confirmation.
assertions: Runs pre-flight checks before creating objects
Creates objects paused or as a draft
Reads back created objects and logs IDs
Asks a specific activation question naming objects and budget
Does not activate or publish without explicit activation approval

evals.prompt: Just write me 5 Facebook ad headlines for my coffee shop's new iced latte.
evals.expected_output: This is a copy-only request; the skill should route to ad-creative rather than run the six-stage pipeline, or answer narrowly without forcing business intake.
assertions: Does not force the full six-stage pipeline for a copy-only request
Points to or uses ad-creative for headline variants
